jobs.occupation: Internship (d/f/m) within Airbus site Artificial Intelligence Centre (AIC) (Elektroniker/in - Luftfahrttechnische Systeme)
jobs.description:
About us

Airbus pioneers sustainable aerospace for a safe and united world. The Company constantly innovates to provide efficient and technologically-advanced solutions in aerospace, defence, and connected services. In commercial aircraft, Airbus offers modern and fuel-efficient airliners and associated services. Airbus is also a European leader in defence and security and one of the world's leading space businesses. In helicopters, Airbus provides the most efficient civil and military rotorcraft solutions and services worldwide.
Job description

In order to support the Site Management Bremen, Airbus is looking for a

Intern (d/f/m) within Airbus site Artificial Intelligence Centre (AIC)

Are you looking for an internship and want to get to know the work of the Airbus Site AI team? Then apply now! We look forward to you supporting us in the AIC project as an intern (d/f/m)! - Bremen AI Centre is a trans functional (production, engineering, IT, Quality …) and trans Business Unit (Airbus Commercial, Airbus Defence & Space, TESTIA…) project that generates AI solutions for a wide range of applications.

- Location: Bremen
- Start: 01.11.2026
- Duration: 4-6 months

Your location

Bremen is a charming city full of history in the northwest of Germany. In addition to being one of the country’s greenest cities, it offers wonderful sights, a rich culture, urban flair and culinary delights. It’s also a great place for seaside lovers, being located just an hour’s drive from the North Sea coast.

Your benefits

- Work-life balance with a 35-hour week (flexitime) and EUR 750 gross/monthly salary.
- A final thesis is possible after consultation with the department.
- International environment with the opportunity to network globally.
- Work with modern/diversified technologies.
- Opportunity to participate in the Generation Airbus Community to expand your own network.

Your tasks and responsibilities

- Prepare and join AIC network meetings.
- Support the AIC core team in all operational aspects.
- Provide codes for real AI use cases from different disciplines.
- Summarize and document results.

Desired skills and qualifications

- Enrolled full-time student (d/f/m) in Computer Science, Data Science, IT, or a related field. We also encourage applications from students in engineering disciplines such as Material Science, Aerospace Engineering, or Mechanical Engineering, as you bring valuable domain-specific knowledge to our AI projects.
- First practical experience in the field of Artificial Intelligence applications is mandatory (best from google like vertex AI, or other ones like TensorFlow / PyTorch).
- Good experiences with Python.
- Fluent in English & good language skills in German
- Good communication skills.

Please upload the following documents: cover letter, CV, relevant transcripts, enrolment certificate.

Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth.

Take your career to a new level and apply online (https://www.airbus.com/en/careers) now!

This job requires an awareness of any potential compliance risks and a commitment to act with integrity, as the foundation for the Company’s success, reputation and sustainable growth

By submitting your CV or application you are consenting to Airbus using and storing information about you for monitoring purposes relating to your application or future employment. This information will only be used by Airbus.
Airbus is committed to achieving workforce diversity and creating an inclusive working environment. We welcome all applications irrespective of social and cultural background, age, gender, disability, sexual orientation or religious belief.

At Airbus, we support you to work, connect and collaborate more easily and flexibly. Wherever possible, we foster flexible working arrangements to stimulate innovative thinking.

Deine VisionYou want your passion for outstanding mobile experiences to give patients access to treatment around the clock, not just during pharmacy or doctor’s office opening hours? Then join Bloomwell. We are one of the leading health tech companies in medical cannabis, with the mission to make access to therapy as simple as possible for patients. Digital, patient centric and fast growing.
As Senior Flutter Developer you maintain and improve our user app for iOS, Android and Web, the cross platform product that connects patients, doctors and our care teams throughout the entire treatment journey. You work closely with Product, Design and Engineering to keep the app intuitive, accessible and reliable for users from very different backgrounds. You work AI native, take full ownership of your domain, and make sure that what you ship actually improves the patient experience, not just closes a ticket
Deine Aufgaben
• Maintain and improve our user app for iOS, Android and Web, built with Flutter
• Design and implement new features end to end, from UI down to state management, dependency injection and modularization
• Build and maintain the app’s networking, offline capabilities, authentication and platform integrations
• Write automated tests and keep our CI/CD, release automation and monitoring healthy as a natural part of your workflow
• Integrate REST APIs, push notifications, analytics, feature flags, crash reporting and third party SDKs
• Use AI coding assistants and agents as a core part of your toolbox, to move faster and improve code quality
• Shape our Flutter architecture, coding standards and engineering culture together with the team
• Work closely with Product, Design and QA to validate solutions with real user feedback and iterate instead of chasing perfection
• Dive into backend services, APIs or native platform code whenever the problem requires it

The position is initially limited to 18 months. This is in accordance with our internal governance and planning principles, under which we initially structure employment relationships for a defined period. Provided performance is satisfactory, there is generally the prospect of a long-term continuation of the employment relationship. A possible extension will be discussed well in advance of the fixed-term contract’s expiration.

Dein Profil
• Extensive experience building and maintaining production grade Flutter applications, with deep knowledge of Dart and modern Flutter architecture (state management, dependency injection, modularization, testing, performance)
• Solid understanding of mobile architecture beyond the UI layer, including networking, offline capabilities, security, authentication, platform integrations, accessibility and app lifecycle management
• Automated testing, CI/CD, localization, monitoring, release automation and code reviews are simply part of how you build software
• AI native, you use modern LLMs, coding agents and AI powered workflows daily to increase delivery speed, improve code quality and support architecture, testing and debugging
• Ownership mentality, you make pragmatic technical decisions that maximize customer value while minimizing complexity and operational risk
• Engineer first, you’re comfortable diving into backend services, APIs, cloud infrastructure or native platform integrations whenever the problem requires it
• Experience integrating REST APIs, authentication flows, push notifications, analytics, feature flags, crash reporting and third party SDKs
• Stakeholder centric, you enjoy understanding product problems together with Product, Design and QA before jumping into implementation
• Fluent German and English, you work closely with our Frankfurt based team on site
• Willingness to work from our Frankfurt office three days a week, with the rest remote

Warum wir?You get to actively shape things from day one, in a growing market, with flat hierarchies and real room to decide. No slow moving structures, just fast paths and an open culture where your ideas count.This is what you can expect:
• Ownership from day one with a direct line to management
• Flexible working hours and hybrid work, three days a week on site in our Frankfurt office, the rest remote
• eGym Wellpass for health and fitness
• Job-Bike
• Fresh fruit, snacks and drinks in our Frankfurt office near the Messe
• Regular team events and a vibrant company culture

*We use the gender neutral abbreviation (m/w/d) to indicate that this position is open to all genders.

We are one of the leading health tech companies in medical cannabis, with the mission to make access to therapy as simple as possible for patients. Digital, patient centric and fast growing.

You split your time between implementing marketing requirements such as tracking, integrations and analytics, and building the backend infrastructure that powers our marketing capabilities. Provided performance is satisfactory, there is generally the prospect of a long-term continuation of the employment relationship. A possible extension will be discussed well in advance of the fixed-term contract’s expiration.

Dein Profil
• Several years of solid, hands-on experience of professional software development experience with strong TypeScript and Node.js skills as your primary stack
• Experience with Flutter or willingness to learn it, since you will work on our mobile and web app
• Solid knowledge of tracking and analytics tools such as Adjust, Usercentrics, Google Tag Manager, Google Analytics 4 and Firebase Analytics, as well as social platform integrations
• Understanding of platform tracking restrictions including iOS ATT, Android privacy changes and web cookie or GDPR requirements
• Comfortable working AI first with tools such as Cursor, Copilot or MCP integrations to automate repetitive work
• Ownership mentality, you prioritize ruthlessly, ship to production and validate real business value rather than just completing tickets
• Nice to have: HubSpot CRM experience, Webflow, notification services such as push, email or SMS, background in marketing technology or growth engineering, previous startup experience

Warum wir?You get to actively shape things from day one, in a growing market, with flat hierarchies and real room to decide. No slow moving structures, just fast paths and an open culture where your ideas count.

Seit unserer Gründung im Jahr 2020 gestalten wir ein innovatives, digitales Cannabis-Ökosystem – mit dem klaren Ziel, die Versorgung von Patient:innen zu verbessern und die moderne Cannabistherapie voranzutreiben. Your visionUse your passion for a great user experience and your technical skills to help patients getting the right treatment without jumping through hoops such as the opening hours of pharmacies and doctor's offices.
You and the team build a platform for patients, doctors and our patient care team allowing everybody to collaborate across the full patient care cycle. The diverse user groups and their backgrounds demand simple, intuitive and high quality interfaces that you conceptualize and build in close collaboration with the team. Come join us and let us shape an emerging market.
Your mission We are looking for someone who:
• Understands and can anticipate the complexities of distributed asynchronous systems.
• Would not need instruction on how to set up or work with modern tech. This means everything from testing, localization, tooling, CI pipelines and so on. These are just “the way you work”
• Thrives in an environment of freedom to take ownership and make the choices required to deliver the highest value at the lowest cost and risk to our users.
• Values an iterative approach to solving a problem, validating the value and moving forwards.
• Is an engineer not bound by labels. We are looking for people with a good foundation of programming practices that can work on front end, dev ops, back end or native app problems to name a few examples. They would not be expected to be a “guru” at something right off the bat, but they would be expected to not fear diving into something new. Our Tech Stack is based on TypeScript, ReactJS, nodeJS, PHP, AWS and Flutte but this position will mostly working with React JS and node JS.
• Is a critical thinker who will design solutions that represent the business domain.
• Is stakeholder centric when trying to solve problems for them. This would mean wanting to truly understand the business domain and get as much information as possible from stakeholders before implementation of a solution.
• Is an exceptional communicator. They will need to have a fluent grasp of English and German would be a plus. This is integral to stakeholder centricity as communication is going to lead to the right solutions.
• Ideally would have a good history of working directly with departments like data analytics so when building software they have them in mind as part of the solution.

The position is initially limited to 18 months. This is in accordance with our internal governance and planning principles, under which we initially structure employment relationships for a defined period. Provided performance is satisfactory, there is generally the prospect of a long-term continuation of the employment relationship. A possible extension will be discussed well in advance of the fixed-term contract’s expiration.

Your profile What we can offer you:
• Flat structures, you will not have the feeling that you have a ‘Boss’
• Transparency is a first class citizen in the company
• Freedom from a JIRA todo list with no deviation. We want to hire people who tell us how to make the right choices and do the right things. We just want to present the problems that need solving.
• We are going to move and scale fast. There is plenty of room for career progression and we intend to hire the best talent we can get. This means you will learn a ton from very talented people.
• Trust, we are looking for people we do not need to manage.
• We don’t measure effort in “time” and we also don’t try to just translate story points to time either.
• We don’t believe in tech debt / bug sprints. Tech debt will always continue to happen, we simply acknowledge pain points and fix them as we go.

No tech is final. We want to use the tech that makes sense for the problem. That could mean a mongodb for one service and dynamo for another. We want you to be able to make that call.

About usThe Frankfurt-based Bloomwell Group wants to redefine the cannabis industry and write a new episode in its history. Their vision is to become the leading hub in a new cannabis ecosystem - both for recreational and medicinal cannabis. We are convinced that it is time to take a new path and move beyond cannabis as a means to relieve discomfort for patients. We believe in cannabis as a statement by people who dare to look within themselves and lead a sophisticated, modern and community-oriented life.

The Process Architect Plan-to-Produce (m/f/d) supports the Process Owner and Global Process Owner in defining future-state business processes, translating business requirements into solution designs, and ensuring the successful deployment of standardized end-to-end production processes across all manufacturing sites.

Your responsibilities:

- Translate business needs from manufacturing sites into clear process requirements, functional specifications, user requirements, and solution design inputs.
- Collaborate with Solution Architects, IT teams, MES experts, Quality, Warehouse Operations, Planning, and Production stakeholders to design scalable, compliant, and standardized SAP S/4HANA PP-PI processes.
- Support Fit-to-Template workshops, design validation, and decision preparation for template deviations or local requirements.
- Define and maintain process models, process flows, business rules, and documentation for Level 2 and Level 3 Plan-to-Produce processes, ensuring alignment with end-to-end value streams.
- Contribute to master data governance for production-relevant objects such as BOMs, master recipes, routings, work centers/resources, production versions, and planning parameters, in collaboration with Global Data Stewards.
- Support the definition of data migration concepts, cleansing rules, validation checks, and mock-load activities to ensure high data quality for production master data.
- Support test strategy and execution, including preparation of test scenarios, OQ/PQ documentation, defect clarification, business validation, and coordination of site testing activities.
- Deliver process and system training, and support user adoption during deployment, hypercare, and continuous improvement phases.
- Identify process risks, issues, dependencies, and improvement opportunities, and support the Process Owner in prioritization, decision tracking, and project management activities.

Your qualifications:

- University degree in Business Administration, Engineering, Supply Chain Management, Information Systems, Life Sciences, or a comparable field.
- At least 5 years of relevant experience in production, business process management, ERP transformation, or process architecture, preferably in the pharmaceutical, MedTech, nutrition, or other regulated industry.
- Strong end-to-end understanding of Plan-to-Produce processes, including production planning, production execution, shop-floor operations, quality integration, warehouse integration, and master data dependencies.
- Hands-on knowledge of SAP S/4HANA manufacturing capabilities, including PP-PI, Fiori apps, and related cross-functional integration points.
- Solid understanding of production master data objects.
- Strong analytical and structured problem-solving skills, with the ability to assess complex process dependencies and propose pragmatic, standardized solutions.
- Excellent communication, facilitation, presentation, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to engage effectively with global, cross-functional, and site-based teams.
- High learning agility, adaptability to evolving business requirements and technologies, and strong motivation to drive harmonization and continuous improvement.
- Business fluency in English, both written and spoken; additional languages are an advantage.
- Willingness to travel internationally, approximately 30%, depending on project and deployment needs.

Our offer

Drive the future of our company — join #futurefresenius and apply now through our online portal to make an impact!

Contact

Apply now (https://apply.jcd.de/Apply.php?iJobAdID=107202&tc=3-11)

jobs.occupation: Bioprocess Engineer – Fermentation, Process Engineering and Automation (m/f/d) (Ingenieur/in - Biotechnologie)
jobs.description:
Job Title:

Bioprocess Engineer – Fermentation, Process Engineering and Automation (m/f/d)

Team CCU Process Development

☀️About Us:

Join the COLIPI-an family as a hands-on Bioprocess Engineer and be at the forefront of scaling and commercializing novel bioprocesses to supply the world with microbial Climate Oil as an alternative to vegetable and fossil oils. COLIPI is dedicated to Fermenting Renewable Carbon For Generational Life Quality, utilizing renewable carbon sources and CO2 transformation to produce valuable biomaterials and contribute to the intensifying fight against global warming.

We develop gas fermentation processes for the sustainable production of bulk and high value products. Our work focuses on advanced fermentation technologies, the development and scale-up of novel bioreactor concepts, and the automation of bioprocess systems.

To strengthen our technical team, we are looking for candidates strong in fermentation and process engineering. Experience in automation is a major plus.

This is not a purely theoretical or desk-based position. You should enjoy developing technical concepts, selecting components, building and commissioning equipment, conducting experiments, and solving problems directly at the plant.

At the same time, you should be able to translate biological requirements into robust process engineering and automation solutions.

🔬Key Responsibilities:

- Support planning, building and optimizing a novel gas fermentation platform from laboratory to pilot scale
- Hands-on work during setup of the systems
- Plan, conduct, and evaluate fermentation experiments in close collaboration with the biological development team
- Analyze biological and technical process data and derive practical measures for process improvement
- Identify and troubleshooting issues in fermentation and process control automation
- Plan and support scale-up and scale-down activities

🛠️Qualifications:

- Legal permit to work in Europe
- Master’s degree in bioprocess engineering, biochemical engineering, process engineering, biotechnology, automation engineering, or a related field
- Alternatively, a comparable technical qualification combined with extensive and demonstrably equivalent professional experience
- Several years of hands-on experience with microbial fermentation processes, bioreactor operation, and bioprocess automation
- Strong understanding of the interactions between biological processes, reactor design, and process conditions
- Experience in (bio-)process automation and control engineering
- Experience with LabVIEW, C/C++, Python, or similar programming languages is an advantage
- Familiarity with programming in LabVIEW, C related or python related languagues would be a plus
- Independent, structured, and solution-oriented approach to work
- Strong hands-on mentality and enthusiasm for both designing and physically building and operating equipment
- Good written and spoken English; German skills (B2) are an advantage

🥰We Offer:

- Direct ownership of pilot-scale systems
- Building first-of-a-kind reactors
- Working with the founding team
- Influence on technology roadmap
- Opportunity to shape engineering standards from the ground up
- Competitive salary and 28 days of paid holidays
- Short decision-making processes and the opportunity to implement your own technical ideas
- Laptop and personal safety gear (goggles, coat, shoes) and training
- Be part of an international team, blending academia with passionate startup vibes
- Embrace an open feedback culture, flat hierarchies, and short decision-making processes
- Access a fully equipped lab, cutting-edge technology, and ample room for personal development
- Participation in advanced training programs
- Annual performance appraisal meeting with manager, in addition to more frequent feedback and growth meetings

⛵️Location: Hamburg, Germany

- Enjoy the vibrant atmosphere of the 2nd biggest city and 1st ranked city to live in Germany
- Experience unique maritime charm and a blazing nightlife
- Immerse yourself in a city rich in cultural events, museums, and galleries

A meaningful application via https://colipi.odoo.com/jobs (https://colipi.odoo.com/jobs) will include your

- CV as PDF (no portrait photo)
- Transcript of records (university)
- Recommendation letters from former employers

Job Title: Metabolic Engineer (m/f/d) 

Microbial CO2 Transformation Specialist 

10 September 2026 

☀️About Us: 

Join the COLIPIan family as a Metabolic Engineer and help us develop next-generation microbial CO₂ transformation processes. 

At COLIPI, we are developing sustainable bioprocesses that use renewable carbon, including CO₂, to produce valuable microbial lipids and biomaterials. Our technology combines unconventional CO₂-utilizing microorganisms, metabolic engineering, and advanced fermentation to create sustainable alternatives to conventional lipid production. 

We are looking for an experienced scientist who can combine experimental strain engineering with metabolic modelling, systems biology, enzyme engineering, and bioinformatics to improve our production strains systematically. 

🧑🏽‍🔬Key Responsibilities: 

- Identify, design, and optimize metabolic pathways for converting CO₂ into lipids and other microbial storage molecules. 
- Develop and implement strain-engineering strategies, including gene knock-outs, overexpression, heterologous pathway expression, promoter engineering, plasmid-based engineering, and CRISPR/Cas-based approaches. 
- Establish, curate, and apply genome-scale metabolic models of our unconventional production strains to identify metabolic bottlenecks, predict engineering targets, and guide strain development. 
- Select and optimize heterologous enzymes and apply enzyme-engineering approaches to improve enzyme activity, stability, expression, and performance within the host microorganism. 
- Analyze and interpret transcriptomics, metabolomics, genomic, and sequencing data to understand cellular physiology and identify new engineering opportunities. 
- Apply bioinformatics tools for genome annotation, pathway analysis, sequence comparison, enzyme identification, and promoter/regulatory-element prediction. 
- Develop genetic tools and engineering strategies for COLIPI's unconventional CO₂-utilizing microbial strains. 
- Plan, execute, and analyze metabolic and genetic engineering experiments and translate results into iterative strain-development strategies. 
- Work closely with fermentation and analytical teams to evaluate engineered strains under relevant cultivation and gas-fermentation conditions. 

🛠️Qualifications: 

- PhD in Metabolic Engineering, Synthetic Biology, Systems Biology, Biotechnology, Biochemistry, Microbiology, or a related field, ideally combined with relevant academic and/or industry experience. 
- Strong background in microbial metabolic engineering, molecular biology, genetic engineering, and synthetic biology. 
- Hands-on experience with strain-engineering techniques such as knock-out/overexpression, cloning, heterologous gene expression, CRISPR/Cas, and directed evolution.

jobs.occupation: Scientist for the development of the German EOSC‑Node (Physiker/in)
jobs.description:
For our location in Hamburg we are seeking:

Scientist for the development of the German EOSC‑Node

Limited: 2 years | Start: earliest possible | ID: FHMA022/2026 | Deadline: 03.10.2026 | Full-time/Part-time | Remote work possible

DESY, with more than 2900 employees at its two locations in Hamburg and Zeuthen, is one of the world's leading research centres. Its research focuses on decoding the structure and function of matter, from the smallest particles of the universe to the building blocks of life. In this way, DESY contributes to solving the major questions and urgent challenges facing science, society and industry. With its ultramodern research infrastructure, its interdisciplinary research platforms and its international networks, DESY offers a highly attractive working environment in the fields of science, technology and administration as well as for the education of highly qualified young scientists.

The DESY Information Technology (IT) division participates in a wide range of high-profile national and European projects, evaluating and developing innovative IT technologies. One of its key activities is the establishment of the German EOSC Node in collaboration with ten leading research institutions across Germany as part of the National Research Data Infrastructure (NFDI). This initiative requires close coordination across more than 300 German universities and research institutions, as well as with national and European research infrastructures.
To support this ambitious endeavour, we are seeking a scientist with expertise in modern web technologies, particularly the development of user-facing web portals and backend services. The successful candidate will be motivated to contribute to the design, development, and operation of these technologies within the evolving European Open Science Cloud (EOSC) ecosystem.

About your role:

- You will contribute to the overall architecture and the design of the German NFDI EOSC Node
- You will coordinate the selection and methodology for developing a service portfolio compatible with existing requirements for the EOSC Node
- You will enhance and deploy a portal for accessing Web Services for the EOSC Node
- You will ensure that the representation of service records is harmonized and aligned with interoperability specifications in the EOSC
- You will participate in regular project meetings, workshops and conferences, both online and in person, and you will contribute to regular reports towards the project management

About you:

- You have completed a master's degree in computer science, physics or related subjects
- You have good knowledge of Web Technologies and at least one modern programming language
- Familiarity with modern cloud technologies, such as CI/CD and Kubernetes, is beneficial
- Experience with user-facing web portals, REST APIs and/or backend development is a plus
- You have good spoken and written command of the English Ianguage
- You are a collaborative team player who enjoys working in large, international teams
- You are open to travel

Good reasons to join:

Look forward to a unique working environment on our international research campus. Respectful cooperation and the well-being of our DESY employees are particularly important to us. Gender equality is an important aspect for us. To support work-life balance we offer flexible working hours, variable part-time, job-sharing models and participation in mobile work (up to 50%). You will benefit from our family-friendly and collegial atmosphere, our established health management and occupational pension provision. As a public funded employer, we offer you a secure workplace and facilitate your individual career with our comprehensive training and development opportunities. Remuneration is according to the regulations of the TV-AVH. DESY offers its employees a financial supplement for a German job ticket (Deutschland-Ticket) at both locations.

For further information, please contact Tim Wetzel at +49 40 8998‑2911 (https://tel:+494089982911)  **(Tim.Wetzel@desy.de (https://mailto:Tim.Wetzel@desy.de) ).**
